scope: Read-only examination of the append-only engine audit outputs specified by the task. No engine restart, reconfiguration, wallet action, or external exchange query was performed.
interpretation: The audit files are present and contain concrete historical records. The sampled entries are not correlated to a controlled UI wallet action or to any of the 19 acceptance assertions. Their presence therefore establishes only that these audit streams contain records; it does not establish any UI write, config/wallet_gate persistence, hot engine reload, wallet-specific Testnet behavior, exchange position/order/fill oracle, or negative test. No row can be passed from this evidence alone.

records.proof_assertion: UI add -> config/wallet_gate write -> running engine hot-reads it -> future genuine Testnet events only, without historical replay/catch-up.
records.reason: No controlled add-wallet UI action or matching action/config hash/engine-read/event correlation was present in the inspected audit evidence.

records.proof_assertion: UI remove/archive -> config and wallet_gate change -> hot engine response with owned exposure/archive safety.
records.reason: OD-13 is open; no wallet-removal action, owned-exposure archive evidence, or correlated Testnet outcome exists in the inspected records.

records.proof_assertion: UI enable -> persisted wallet state -> hot engine read -> Testnet behavior for an enabled wallet.
records.audit_ref: send_attempts.csv:2 (unbound historical ORDER_FILLED sample); order_intents.csv:2 (unbound sample)
records.reason: No controlled enable action or evidence correlates these historical engine records to a wallet enabled through the UI.

records.proof_assertion: UI disable -> persisted config -> running engine ceases new wallet work while handling owned exposure as specified.
records.reason: No controlled disable action or subsequent wallet-specific event window is identified in the inspected audit records.

records.proof_assertion: UI CLO update -> hot engine behavior permits reductions while blocking new exposure, confirmed by Testnet state.
records.reason: No controlled CLO update and paired allowed-reduction/blocked-entry outcomes are correlated in the inspected records.

records.proof_assertion: UI mode change -> persisted setting -> hot engine sizing behavior -> Testnet order/position oracle.
records.reason: OD-02 is open; no ruled mode authority or controlled before/after sizing test is evidenced.

records.proof_assertion: UI norm-base update -> persisted config -> hot engine sizing uses the selected normalization base.
records.reason: No controlled norm-base change is linked to an intent and exchange outcome in the inspected records.

records.proof_assertion: UI fixed-notional update -> persisted config -> hot engine uses fixed sizing in Testnet.
records.reason: OD-02 is open; no ruled fixed-mode authority or controlled fixed-notional order proof is evidenced.

records.proof_assertion: UI leader-equity-base update -> persisted config -> hot engine computes proportional size from the selected base.
records.reason: No controlled base change, attributable sizing intent, and independent Testnet oracle are correlated in the inspected records.

records.proof_assertion: Wallet state/target change is represented correctly by the live engine and reconciles against actual Testnet positions.
records.reason: The historical samples do not establish this wallet's state transition or match it to an exchange position snapshot.

records.proof_assertion: UI wallet/config change persists across restart and engine resumes with the intended state.
records.reason: No restart or before/after config hash evidence was collected; task expressly prohibits restarting/reconfiguring the engine.

records.proof_assertion: Invalid UI wallet input is rejected without changing persisted config or engine wallet state.
records.audit_ref: errors.csv:2 (historical row not correlated to an invalid-input probe)
records.reason: No invalid-input UI probe was run and the sampled error record is not bound to one.

records.feature: USER/account wallet can never be enabled
records.proof_assertion: Attempt to enable the USER/account wallet is rejected and cannot affect copy sends.
records.reason: No attempted USER-wallet enable and correlated rejection/no-send evidence exists in the inspected records.

records.proof_assertion: UI and engine mode writers converge on a single persisted authority and hot-read behavior.
records.reason: OD-05 is open; no resolved authority or controlled cross-writer consistency probe is evidenced.

records.proof_assertion: Admin purge removes/archives wallet data without deleting or corrupting owned exposure or audit history.
records.reason: OD-13 is open; no purge action or before/after owned-exposure and audit-retention proof is present.

records.proof_assertion: UI include/exclude setting is persisted and hot-read, with expected portfolio aggregation and no execution-side effect beyond its defined scope.
records.reason: No controlled INC toggle and attributable before/after portfolio evidence is correlated in these execution audit files.

records.proof_assertion: Wallet metadata update persists and is represented without altering wallet execution identity or behavior.
records.reason: Execution audit records do not establish a UI metadata update or its persisted representation; no controlled metadata probe was run.

records.proof_assertion: Duplicate add and archived-wallet re-add are handled according to the rule without unintended duplicate execution.
records.reason: No duplicate/re-add UI action or paired deduplication/no-duplicate-send evidence exists in the inspected records.

records.proof_assertion: Wallet subscription coverage includes the configured wallet and produces attributable future events, with no replay outside the specified baseline.
records.reason: No subscription-change event, baseline marker, or wallet-correlated future-only Testnet evidence was identified.

safety: Read-only only; no engine reconfiguration, restart, wallet operation, or external exchange action.
